text:
Girard reported 1 licensed child care facility in 2025
In 2025, Girard had one licensed child care facility, according to the Illinois Department of Children and Family Services.
The single child care provider in the area was categorized as a Day Care Home.
Providers in Girard offer services primarily for children from birth up to 12 years old.
The facility provides care in English.
Across Illinois, there were 8,602 licensed child care facilities in 2025.
The U.S. Department of Health and Human Services has temporarily frozen certain federal child care and family assistance funding for California, Colorado, Minnesota, New York and Illinois because of concerns about fraud and misuse, the agency announced Jan. 6. The hold affects nearly $2.4 billion in Child Care and Development Fund grants, $7.35 billion in Temporary Assistance for Needy Families funds and $869 million in Social Services Block Grants, requiring states to present documentation before funds are released.
Illinois Gov. J.B. Pritzker condemned the move as “wrong and cruel” and indicated the state may challenge the freeze, stating that current anti-fraud policies are already in place in Illinois.
State officials said the freeze could impact about 100,000 families and over 152,000 children participating in Illinois’ Child Care Assistance Program, along with funds for thousands of licensed child care facilities and 275 human service agencies.
